    - heading "Our view on energy" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The demand for renewable energy is increasing. Then there’s the onset of electrification and improvements in energy storage. All key drivers of the energy transition, which aims to reduce energy-related greenhouse gas emissions through decarbonisation. At Fugro, we support energy projects through every stage of the value chain. We help improve the efficiency of energy generation and minimise the impact on our environment. So everyone can access energy to power their homes and businesses.

    - heading "Fugro's Analysis - Offshore Wind O&M Market & Future Prospects" [level=2]
    - paragraph: We help clients predict their energy output at a certain moment in time and advise whether it’s more cost-effective for the turbines to be on or off.
    - paragraph: Business news
    - heading "Fugro’s geo-data supports development of UK’s first flexible power station with carbon capture technology" [level=2]
    - paragraph: When complete, Keadby 3 could become the UK’s first flexible power station equipped with carbon capture technology. Every year, it could capture up to 1.5 million tonnes of carbon.
    - paragraph: Podcast
    - heading "Net zero vessels – Progress on future fuels" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "In this episode: with vessel redesign and operational changes on the horizon, a green industry may not be too far in the future."
    - paragraph: Long read
    - heading "Accelerating the development of subsea remote and autonomous solutions with the National Robotarium" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Our partnership with the National Robotarium allows us to leverage our combined technical expertise, extensive network, project funding and large-scale, cutting-edge facilities to help accelerate the development of ground-breaking autonomous underwater solutions that deliver added value to our clients.
    - paragraph: Fugro World article
    - heading "Technology’s role in the future energy mix" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Globally, there’s an ever-increasing level of understanding and awareness amongst wider society, that a sustainable future and a diverse energy mix are intrinsically linked. When it comes to the process of energy production, the focus cannot solely be on how to do more but on how to do better. This means ensuring that actions in the short term do not adversely affect the long-term health of the planet.
